## How it was tested

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pnpm test:db` or `pnpm test:browser` run, if the server or the UI changed
- [ ] Docs and `.env.example` updated, if behaviour or settings changed
- [ ] Migrations only added, never edited
- [ ] No secrets or personal data
- [ ] The title uses [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/orhunakkan/agentic-library/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how pull requests are tested and merged.
